{{Quote|Domination of the galactic underworld begins now, with a massive strike on Nantoon.|[[Bala-Tik]], in the ''Smuggler's Guide''|<ref name="Smuggler's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Nantoon''' was a world in the [[Colonies]] region of [[the galaxy]] where the [[pirate]] [[Queen]] [[Maz Kanata]] hid a portion of the spoils of her reign in a buried vault protected by an [[antitamper sub-space alarm]]. As of the [[time]] that Kanata began writing the [[book]] that would become known as the ''[[Smuggler's Guide]]'', the alarm on Nantoon had not sounded. The [[Guavian Death Gang]], a criminal group, sought to launch a [[strike on Nantoon]] to rule over the [[galaxy]]'s underworld.<ref name="Smuggler's Guide" />

In [[34 ABY]] the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] and his co-[[pilot]] [[Chewbacca]] stole a number of relics from the world and stored them in a container on their [[Baleen-class heavy freighter|''Baleen''-class heavy freighter]] ''[[Eravana]]''.<ref name="ICS">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> When Solo left the planet in his ship he was tracked and shadowed by the Guavian Death Gang, to whom he owed fifty thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. They caught up with him over the [[planet]] [[Jakku]], but Solo and Chewbacca escaped in the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', which they had captured above Jakku.<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Nantoon was first mentioned in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], which was released in [[2015]].<ref name="TFA" />
